record.question:
World AIDS Day is a global observance held on 1st December every year to raise awareness about
    the HIV/AIDS epidemic. The global theme for World Aids Day 2025 was:
options: Take the rights path: My health, my right!
Overcoming disruption, transforming the AIDS response.
